text:
Alice: Quick heads-up: scheduling a narrow schema migration for payments.transactions tonight 01:30 UTC. Add nullable `processed_at` + small backfill over tenant slices. Change window 01:30-02:30 UTC.
Ben: ok. What's our safe abort/rollback criteria?
Alice: Proposed: abort if lock wait >4s sustained for 3m, or write error rate >1% rolling 5m, or replication lag >10s. Rollback plan: 1) stop backfill workers, 2) flip feature-flag to skip writes, 3) if still unsafe, reverse migration (manual) and notify customers.
Carla: let's avoid big exclusive locks by using ORDER BY id LIMIT chunk and WHERE id > last_id pattern. I'll add jitter and exponential sleep between chunks.
Dave: +1 for chunking. I'll run a preflight sample against 3 high-volume tenants at 00:40 UTC and post per-tenant timings.
Frank: small ask: can we pin the migration tooling version? last time we hit a worker memory regression. Request pin to db-migrate v2.8.0 for the run.
Ben: deploybot, schedule migration for 2024-09-12T01:30Z, pin db-migrate v2.8.0 for canary. Canary: tenant slice by hash mod, 5% first.
deploybot: Migration queued by @ben for 2024-09-12T01:30Z (db-migrate v2.8.0). Canary slice: 5% hashed tenants. Hooks: lockwatch, p99-db-latency, write-errors.
Alice: Runbook summary: 
- preflight at 00:40 UTC (Dave)
- canary start 01:30 (5% tenants)
- escalate if: lock wait >4s sustained 3m OR write error rate >1% for 5m OR repl lag >10s
- abort flow: stop workers, flip flag, terminate lingering backfill queries, promote fallback read-replica for reads if needed
- rollback flow: manual reverse migration + DB schema patch note

Alice: Abort commands (snippet):
```
# toggle skip
POST /feature-flag/payments_backfill_skip true
# stop workers
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/backfill-workers --replicas=0
# terminate stuck queries (careful)
psql -c "SELECT pid, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%UPDATE payments.transactions%'";
psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%UPDATE payments.transactions%' AND state <> 'idle'";
# if needed: rails db:migrate:down VERSION=20240912001
```

Carla: I'll add a remote debug endpoint to the worker so we can inspect last processed id. Flag it behind ops-only toggle.
Dave: Preflight (00:40) results: 5k sample per tenant. avg backfill row time: 0.9ms, 99th: 6ms, peak lock wait observed: 0.5s. Replication lag stable <0.2s. Charts: https://internal.ops/charts/4132461111/preflight
Ben: numbers look good. Frank: ok with v2.8.0 pin?
Frank: Yes, confirmed. I also added worker memory alert to the runbook (heap >1.5GB for 3m).
Eve: I'll draft release notes: "Add nullable processed_at column to payments.transactions. Backfill run in maintenance window; no PK changes. Canaries will run on 5% tenant slice." Will link for review.
deploybot: Canary started 01:30Z 1:35 processed, monitoring hooks active. Canary progress: 5% slice complete 12m, no alerts.
Dave: Canary health: p99 latency stable, no lock waits >1s. Posting live logs: https://logs.internal/4132461111/canary
Carla: flipping chunking aggressiveness to faster (reduced sleep) for remainder of slice; will watch tail latencies.
Alice: Decision: promote to 50% after 01:46 if no regressions for 15m. If we hit abort criteria at any point, follow abort flow; if abort fails, escalate to replica promotion plan (ops@).
Ben: tagging on-call @frank @dave for post-canary scaling.
Eve: release notes updated and pager roster in playbook.
Alice: Final: 50% rollout GO at 01:46. Will monitor and post final status when complete.
